title: Cities Skylines | Franklin Episode 5: Eds & Meds 1
premise: The presenter builds early hospital, university, and government institutions in Franklin and argues their benevolence and universal promises conceal quarantine, restricted access, and class privilege; their landscaped beauty contrasts with his account of ineffective care.
coverage: Read the full machine-generated ASR transcript and all 20 original contact sheets, 234 selected frames spanning 0–775 seconds, plus the appended one-frame sheet extra-000235.jpg at 57.1 seconds: 21 indexed sheets / 235 indexed frames inspected. Original sampling uses the first available frame in each 5-second bin plus scene scores >0.30 at 480px width. Native rereads were inspected at 30, 255, 260, 760, and 770 seconds. QA brief candidates at 57.1, 59.167, and 60.4 seconds were also inspected: a missed ABOLISH ICE overlay is now registered and represented with connected setup/payoff. The no-techno promise and classical-music cinematics are also linked. Camera descriptions rely on adjacent samples, not unseen continuous motion. Brief overlays may still be missed. The renderer derives full speech from every timestamped ASR word across panel boundaries; historical claims remain attributed. Empty sound arrays mean unannotated, not silence. panels.heading: Franklin title and city introduction
panels.description: Orange FRANKLIN lettering and bell emblem overlay a high aerial city view; A DONOTEAT SERIES appears beneath.
panels.camera: Intro cuts from black title background to high aerial and closer oblique city views (frames 1–5).
panels.action: Title graphic remains over changing city views; no visible character performance.

panels.heading: Money-back opening; assemble the hospital
panels.description: The editor begins with a short access road beneath a green/red EPISODE 5 / EDS & MEDS 1 banner, dated 1788 → 1799; later the rotunda and wings are assembled.
panels.camera: Overhead and closer oblique framings alternate, briefly pulling back to the city at 45 seconds.
panels.action: The builder places the rotunda and assembles its long wings.
panels.visualGag: Connected setups: the mock no-techno policy pays off with classical-music cinematics at 665 seconds. The presenter also feigns having listened to objections about the previous opening, then says he does not care; the following 55.87-second panel turns his repeated abolish-ICE demand into a large ABOLISH ICE overlay, visually reinforcing defiance rather than apologizing.
panels.notes: Episode banner read at native resolution at 30 seconds. No-techno begins at ASR word onset 39.23; abolish begins at 55.87 and ICE at 56.71, carried by the dedicated overlay panel.

panels.heading: ABOLISH ICE: the non-apology gets a visual punchline
panels.description: Large bold white ABOLISH ICE text overlays the hospital rotunda and construction lawn. The political demand remains emphatic against ordinary city-building footage rather than retreating after viewer complaints.
panels.camera: The overlay stays screen-positioned across 57.1 and 59.167-second overhead editor views as the hospital framing shifts; it is absent in the close frontal view at 60.4. Exact appearance/disappearance boundaries are not established.
panels.action: Text is superimposed while hospital editing continues; no character performance is visible.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the preceding panel's faux apology: I listened leads to I don't care and also abolish ICE, then the demand becomes oversized on-screen text. It reinforces the recurring political opening rather than granting the complainers a softened introduction.
panels.notes: QA found this between original five-second samples. Registered frame 235 at 57.1 seconds and inspected its supplemental sheet; QA candidate 10 confirms continuation at 59.167 and candidate 11 its absence at 60.4. ASR abolish/ICE onsets are 55.87/56.71. QAEarlyFranklin additionally identifies this as a callback to episode 4's ABOLISH ICE opening card; that cross-episode association is reviewer-supplied.

panels.heading: Hospital frontage and access
panels.description: The rotunda and long pale wings form a symmetrical frontage behind a semicircular access road preview.
panels.camera: Frontal view at 60 seconds changes to overhead road-editing views by 65–75 seconds.
panels.action: A curved road is drawn across the hospital lawn.
panels.visualGag: Return from the preceding ABOLISH ICE overlay punchline to ordinary construction: the text is no longer visible in the inspected 60.4-second frontal view. The connected faux-apology payoff belongs to the preceding two panels.
panels.notes: Panel boundary follows the inspected QA candidate showing the overlay gone; no exact removal-frame claim is made.

panels.heading: Physical and mental illness wings
panels.description: Hospital wings flank the rotunda, with perpendicular end blocks and planted paths being added.
panels.camera: The editor rotates around the compound and shifts between end-wing close views and higher overviews (80–105 seconds).
panels.action: Building pieces and paths are selected and repositioned.

panels.heading: Benevolence with catches
panels.description: An oblique view reveals the hospital clock tower and domed center, surrounded by still largely empty grounds.
panels.camera: Rapid reframing around the compound, followed by an overhead front-lawn view.
panels.action: Selections flash red and blue; the builder edits surfaces and paths.

panels.heading: Beautiful frontage, dangerous treatment
panels.description: Orange flowering shrubs outline triangular beds around a small fountain in front of the hospital.
panels.camera: Close front-lawn views pull back to show the whole institution by 155 seconds.
panels.action: Trees, flowers, and a fountain populate the frontage while narration describes overcrowding and poor hygiene.

panels.heading: No germ theory, no anesthesia
panels.description: A close overhead view of the curved road shows a row of circular yellow placement guides beside a flower border.
panels.camera: The editor moves among courtyard, wing, and road-edge views; this is not a medical illustration.
panels.action: Fence/prop placement guides and blue selection outlines move around the grounds.

panels.heading: Whiskey, wood, and speed

panels.camera: Camera shifts from wing edges to rear grounds, then tighter courtyard framing.
panels.action: Ground surfaces are painted and prepared for the formal garden.

panels.heading: Ineffective cures; formal garden geometry
panels.description: Rectangular and L-shaped raised beds are arranged over a fenced red-brick garden surface.
panels.camera: Close overhead framing moves across the garden bed layout.
panels.action: The builder adds and aligns individual planter shapes.

panels.heading: Temporary statue preview during garden building
panels.description: Two turquoise equestrian statues on pale plinths appear beside one another on the garden brickwork.

panels.action: A blue-selected statue/placement preview is moved; the sampled view at 260 seconds shows one statue, and 260.6 shows the plot without these large figures.
panels.notes: Transient duplication is visible, but no deliberate joke or narrated statue reference is established; do not invent comic intent.

panels.heading: Pleasant surroundings versus beatings

panels.action: Benches, beds, and trees are placed as the narrator undercuts pleasant-surroundings therapy with beatings.
panels.notes: The rhetorical joke is spoken; no patient beating or gag insert is visible.

panels.camera: View travels from the small garden to the back of the hospital, then pulls up to the whole compound at 317.2 seconds.

panels.heading: Self-preservation rather than charity

panels.action: Trees and fence/edge props continue to be placed.
